sources.quote: Home - Southwest I-Corps Southwest I-Corps About What We Do Who We Are Our Partners Programs IdeaLaunch NSF National Teams Program FAQs Get Involved Apply for IdeaLaunch Become A Mentor Events News Contact Spurring Innovation The NSF I-Corps™ Hub: Southwest fosters entrepreneurial thinking in academic research to create a thriving innovation ecosystem throughout the region. Why I-CORPS? I-Corps equips academic researchers and engineers with the entrepreneurial skills they need to transform their cutting edge research from invention to impact. The I-Corps program provides the knowledge, tools, and support needed to test commercial viability and spur innovation in the marketplace. DISCOVER » Get Started Southwest I-Corps offers programs to engage your team in the customer discovery process, establish product-market fit, validate your business model, and improve your odds for commercial success. Join a cohort to transfer your ideas from the lab to the marketplace. INITIATE » Stay Informed Gather insight on invention and innovation by connecting to the hub — you’ll learn about I-Corps teams, successes, and upcoming programs near you.
